title: Kata Sound Lab
description: An original retro sound-effects workbench inspired by jsfxr. Start with a preset, shape a sound, and export a WAV for your next little world.

screenshots.alt: Kata Sound Lab desktop workbench with the Coin pickup preset, waveform display, sound controls, and WAV and settings exports.
screenshots.caption: Coin pickup preset in the desktop layout.
